definitions.aggregation: turn ratios -> mean valid turns within question -> equal-weight question mean; across-seed mean is computed separately
definitions.tps: post-first-token emitted tokens / retained decode seconds; subtract the first emitted token only if its step is retained
definitions.conditional: P1/P2/Miss AL and latency average only turns/questions containing that source; absent-source rate is zero, absent-source AL/latency is undefined
definitions.selection: Existing cap/clip, full-batch and >2x grouped-median step exclusions preserved; output<2 or no-decode turns excluded
definitions.mean_identity: Mean AL is not mean TPS times mean latency; conditional means may have different valid question populations
